brief_bug_summary_human_paraphrase: In _guess_delimiter's character-frequency loop, the bugged version uses `line.strip().count(char)` instead of `line.count(char)`. When the delimiter is whitespace and the last field of a line is empty, strip() removes the trailing whitespace delimiter, so the frequency table for that column is undercounted and the sniffer may falsely return '' as the delimiter.
